name: gfx950_asm_probe_kernel
description: Build a standalone probe kernel to characterize a poorly-documented gfx950/CDNA4 instruction's behavior empirically. ~30 min vs hours of doc archaeology.
preconditions: Need to understand semantics of a specific instruction (e.g., ds_read_b64_tr_b16) where docs are unclear or contradict experience
steps: Build minimal .s kernel: load test data to LDS, issue the instruction with various per-lane addressing modes, dump output to HBM via global_store_dwordx4.

Pick test data that creates UNIQUE identifiable values per source position. Two probe modes: V[i,j] = i (row-uniform) and V[i,j] = j (col-uniform). Each output bf16 then identifies which i or j the lane received.
Vary the per-lane addressing formula via a kernarg-selected mode (e.g., probe_mode = 0..3 selects different v_addr patterns).
Run via launcher, dump per-lane output to console. Inspect first 8-10 lanes covering different group boundaries (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, 17, 32, 48).
Cross-reference outputs to determine: which source positions feed which output lane, what transpose pattern HW does, whether all lanes contribute unique addrs or HW broadcasts subsets.
Document the discovered semantics in a reference memory + skill before integrating into the production kernel.
expected_impact: Saves hours of doc reading + speculative implementation. Used to characterize ds_read_b64_tr_b16 semantics on gfx950 (= 4x4 transpose within 16-lane groups with 4-way lane duplication; needs V^T LDS layout to match MFMA-B output).
success_contexts: asm_vsa_fwd week4s_tr_probe.s: characterized ds_read_b64_tr_b16 with 4 v_addr modes x 2 V data patterns. Discovered the 4-way duplication pattern that forced V^T layout requirement.

decision_rules.if: HW instruction behavior is unclear from docs or seems to produce wrong data
decision_rules.then: build a 60-line probe kernel BEFORE integrating into production code

decision_rules.if: probe shows duplicated outputs across lanes within a group
decision_rules.then: HW is doing a smaller transpose tile than 16-lane width; need different LDS layout
